comments:
bb9c27a1: Start checking and printing out performance indicators.
Process each VA FACILITY entry in the UTILITY global.
If the flag DGU is set, quit the loop.
Execute the routine indicated by DGJTL to print each header line.
7a25c4a2: If DGU flag is set, quit.
72c51c77: If not the first page and data exists in the UTILITY global, call the RET subroutine to retrieve data. If DGU flag is set, quit. Call DGJOTP3 to print summary lines.
7e8fa982: Go to the QUIT label in DGJOTP routine.
62aae6b8: Print the abbreviation of the institution number, taken from the VAS file.
4f021cb2: If the report is sorted by status (DGJTDIR=2), print the status abbreviation for the record.
dcbfd722: Set X to the date the record was created. If no date exists, set X to null.
3ab49ade: Print the formatted date, converting spaces to zeros.
923b5a8b: Print the number of dictated lines for the record.
b48fbfdc: Print the number of transcribed lines for the record.
6448bf02: Print the number of altered lines for the record.
100dc10e: Calculate and print the total number of lines for the record. Add the total to the running daily average.
9c0a2398: Calculate and print the number of lines over the 30-day threshold. Add the excess to the running 30-day average.
